objective: One chat turns engineering intent into scoped, observable, interruptible work and reviewable results, while preserving evidence, resource limits and existing authority.

jobs.title: Pin the chat-first journey and evidence contract
jobs.problem: Chat, Manager and Fleet already exist; their shared user journey needs a pinned acceptance contract before adding another orchestration layer.
jobs.deliverable: One contract mapping conversation, turn, delegated task and result identities to existing owning types, plus deterministic fixtures for the golden journey.
acceptance: A fixture follows intent → scoped plan → execution → reviewable artifact → follow-up using stable references.
Existing versus proposed behavior is explicitly marked, with a baseline for each journey scenario.
The contract names the existing owner of each state and rejects a second task or permission store.
validation: Add contract fixture tests for missing task references and mismatched result revisions.
Run npm run typecheck and the new contract tests.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.

jobs.title: Make the first useful chat turn recoverable
jobs.problem: Existing onboarding and Automatic selection need a measured path from empty state to useful response with actionable unavailable-resource states.
jobs.deliverable: A single primary first-turn action that preserves the project and draft through readiness failures.
acceptance: With an eligible fake resource, select a project, send a task and display the first response without choosing a model.
With no eligible resource, show the specific readiness blocker and preserve the draft for retry.
Double submission and readiness retries produce at most one accepted turn; keyboard focus reaches the recovery action.
validation: Extend start-chat and OnboardingFlow tests with unavailable, retry and double-submit cases.
Run npm run test:web for the touched onboarding/chat suites and affected backend readiness tests.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.

jobs.title: Keep one conversation coherent across interruption
jobs.problem: Persisted chat and turn queue primitives need an explicit reconnect and interrupted-turn acceptance boundary.
jobs.deliverable: Recovery behavior for an interrupted foreground conversation using existing turn identities and storage.
acceptance: Reload during a streamed turn restores committed messages and distinguishes interrupted from completed work.
Repeated or out-of-order events cannot duplicate a message or attribute another turn’s output to this turn.
Retry requires an explicit action and retains the previous attempt reference; cancellation cannot later display success without evidence.
validation: Add hermetic interruption/replay tests around the existing store and turn queue.
Add DOM tests for reconnect, draft preservation and canceled-turn display.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.

jobs.title: Make project context inspectable and correctable
jobs.problem: Project memory and sources exist; users need to understand which evidence affected a turn and correct stale context.
jobs.deliverable: Task-scoped source provenance and exclusion controls wired to existing context assembly.
acceptance: Each included source shows its origin and freshness; unavailable evidence is labelled unknown.
Excluding a stale source removes it from the next assembled context without deleting unrelated project memory.
Cross-project context is excluded; token overflow retains a visible omission record rather than silently claiming complete coverage.
validation: Extend verse-project-memory and context-fit tests for project isolation, exclusion and bounded context.
Extend SourceList DOM tests for provenance, freshness and keyboard-accessible exclusion.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.

jobs.title: Trace chat intent into bounded delegated work
jobs.problem: Manager already delegates; the remaining slice is a tested chat-to-task handoff with visible scope and durable deduplication.
jobs.deliverable: A handoff receipt linking the original message, scope, existing task IDs and any blocking reason, under owner review for protected Manager changes.
acceptance: Repeated delivery of the same message reference creates one logical handoff, including after restart.
Unenrolled or ambiguously matched projects produce a scoped blocker and no dispatch.
Dormant execution, exhausted allowance, Stop and pause remain refusals; a chat message cannot grant permissions or widen enrollment.
validation: Extend existing Manager conversation/scope tests with duplicate handoff and restart cases in the owner lane.
Run affected authority/refusal regressions unchanged; attach exact commands and results.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.

jobs.title: Explain work and blockers in the originating chat
jobs.problem: Task and activity views exist; delegated work needs consistent progress, blockers and control acknowledgements in the originating conversation.
jobs.deliverable: A projection of existing task state into chat with navigation to detail and explicit pending control states.
acceptance: Queued, running, blocked, failed, canceled and completed fixtures render distinct states with source timestamps.
A stale observation cannot overwrite a newer terminal state; missing evidence is unknown, not success.
Pause or cancel shows pending until acknowledged by the existing control API; a refusal remains visible and retryable.
validation: Extend tasks-model and LiveStatus tests for stale events and every terminal state.
Add TasksTray DOM coverage for control acknowledgement, refusal and focus preservation.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.

jobs.title: Close the loop with reviewable evidence
jobs.problem: Diff and source components exist; a completed task must lead to its exact artifact and validation rather than a prose success claim.
jobs.deliverable: A completion summary that links task, changed files, candidate revision and check evidence, with follow-up in the same conversation.
acceptance: A successful fixture exposes the exact tested revision, changed files and check results.
A failed check or missing artifact cannot render as verified completion; stale evidence is labelled.
A follow-up references the reviewed result and preserves project scope; review does not itself merge, publish or deploy.
validation: Extend DiffBlock, SourceList and turn-files tests for mismatched revisions, missing artifacts and failed checks.
Add a DOM journey from completed task to evidence to follow-up draft.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.

jobs.title: Explain Automatic choices without hiding limits
jobs.problem: Automatic routing and usage views already exist; their rationale must remain grounded in account-specific eligibility and observed usage.
jobs.deliverable: A concise per-turn resource explanation and blocked-selection recovery using existing admission results.
acceptance: Show chosen account/model and observed selection reasons while preserving manual pinning and local-only scope.
Unknown or stale usage is never presented as available quota, zero cost or a measured saving.
Unavailable selected resources preserve the draft and expose a recovery action; explanations cannot override admission, reserves or account exclusions.
validation: Extend turn-resource-evidence tests for missing/stale measurements and account identity.
Run affected advisor and start-chat tests using fake capacity observations.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.

jobs.title: Make companion capability gaps actionable in chat
jobs.problem: Companion availability differs by seat; a chat should explain the capabilities actually available for this task without claiming every seat has every tool.
jobs.deliverable: Task-scoped capability receipts and recovery guidance for existing companion discovery.
acceptance: Fixtures distinguish unavailable, unapproved and ready capabilities for the selected seat.
Phantom Secrets references remain opaque; Locus handles access needs without returning credentials to the transcript.
Tool results carry source references and untrusted content cannot alter scope or permissions; no companion is installed or commissioned merely by viewing a suggestion.
validation: Add seat-view tests for missing companion, rejected permission and malicious tool-result text.
Verify transcript/error fixtures contain references and redacted errors rather than secret values.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.

jobs.title: Measure chat outcomes against a fixed baseline
jobs.problem: The measured leverage ledger exists; chat-first improvements need scenario-level evidence without inventing hours saved or counting messages as progress.
jobs.deliverable: A fixed offline evaluation corpus and report for first useful result, recovery, reviewability and accepted task outcomes.
acceptance: Report success counts and denominators, elapsed time and token coverage independently; missing usage stays unknown.
Compare baseline and candidate on identical fixtures and acceptance rules; a candidate cannot select itself by rewriting its evaluator.
Include failed/interrupted runs and rework; report local fixture evidence separately from installed/provider/user acceptance.
validation: Add deterministic evaluation/report tests including zero observations, partial token coverage and regressions.
Run existing measured-leverage tests unchanged alongside the new evaluation suite.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.

jobs.title: Verify the combined chat-first assistant journey
jobs.problem: Independent feature checks do not prove that the combined assistant works from intent through result and recovery.
jobs.deliverable: A combined acceptance suite and evidence report tied to one candidate revision, plus updated user guidance for demonstrated behavior.
acceptance: Run a single journey: new chat → scoped task → delegated work → inspect checks/diff → follow-up, with one coherent identity chain.
Run no-resource, local-only, stale-context, disconnect, duplicate-event, failed-check and Stop scenarios; each must preserve scope and avoid false success.
Record the candidate revision, exact commands, pass/fail counts and evidence artifacts; label live-provider and installed-app checks unverified until separately performed.
No release claim is made from local tests; retained regressions remain required and missing owner-lane work blocks completion.
validation: Run the combined hermetic journey suite plus all affected backend and web suites with temporary HOME.
Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm run check:docs on the combined candidate.
nonGoals: No new authority, paid resources, release or deployment activation.
